title: The Lenny Kravitz Barbie Is Flying Off the Shelves Just Hours After Its Release — Here’s Where to Buy
summary: The "Fly Away" singer is the second man to be bestowed the "Kenbassador" title by Mattel.
contentText:

Ken has officially entered his rock-star era, with Lenny Kravitz bringing the attitude. Released Sept. 17, 2026, the Barbie Signature Kenbassadors Lenny Kravitz doll captures the singer in a look inspired by his recent Blue Electric Light tour.

Just hours after its release, the Lenny Kravitz Kenbassadors doll is already proving popular with shoppers, as Amazon’s direct inventory is sold out, but higher-priced listings over $100 remain available from Amazon resellers . The collectible marks the second Kenbassador from Mattel, following LeBron James, whose doll debuted in 2025.

Sculpted in Kravitz’s likeness, the collectible features his trademark locs, tattoos and a nose ring, and comes dressed in a bronze-colored mesh cowl-neck tank, boot-cut jeans, a studded belt, boots and sunglasses. The set also includes a doll stand and a certificate of authenticity, with the doll presented in displayable packaging for collectors and fans ages 6 and up.

Mattel

The Lenny Kravitz doll is part of Mattel’s Barbie Signature Kenbassadors Collection, a series created to recognize influential men and celebrate Ken during his 65th anniversary year. LeBron James was the inaugural Kenbassador in 2025, making Kravitz the second figure in the collection. Mattel is celebrating Kravitz as a multi-hyphenate artist whose work spans music, fashion, acting, design and production. The company also highlights his more than 50 million records sold worldwide and his lasting influence across music and culture.

Kravitz’s doll is Mattel’s latest creation of celebrities to join the Signature family, with Whitney Houston , Marilyn Monroe and Kylie Minogue also getting their own personalized doll this year.
